name: Failed-flush continuation short (5m short the mid-acceleration cascade)
rationale: MECHANISM (H6 on 5m — the acceleration timescale): a cascade that is still consuming its liquidation ladder accelerates over minutes (14.6x mid-event Oct-2025), so a 5m bar catches the continuation while the ladder below is still being hit. OI falls, price prints new lows, no bounce — forced sellers remain below. Counterparty: the next tranche of margin-called longs. Run as a perp SHORT. Entry: open_interest cross_down (deleveraging) AND range_position below a very low floor (new lows, no bounce) AND rsi below an oversold floor (still bleeding) AND funding_rate below a small-negative ceiling (room to fall before shorts crowd). DISCONFIRMER: must be time-disjoint from H1 — shared profitable bars mean noise; range_position is the distinguisher, so its removal must collapse the spec. HIGH curve-fit risk on a fast bar — the 5m fee drag makes the bar for a real edge stricter; kill unless a clean low-overlap OOS window clears ~20bps net.
catalyst: 5m OI cross_down + fresh new low + no bounce — a cascade still mid-acceleration
